aggregation: pooled out-of-fold (each image scored once by the fold that never saw its group)
limitations: Exploratory case/slide-group independence over 4 groups ONLY; patient-level independence unverified.
P9 fold is single-class (NON_TUMOR) -> VIABLE/NECROSIS not estimable there.
Case-3 VIABLE test support=3 and Case-48 NECROSIS test support=2 are indicative-only.
Patches are not independent biological samples; no patch-as-patient bootstrap.
Scores are uncalibrated model class scores, not disease probabilities.
One seed (42); multi-seed stability is a future approval-gated step.
